title: tetracera nordtiana var. everillii
intro: Tetracera nordtiana var. everillii, commonly known as the Everill's Beehive Tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Columellaceae family. It is a shrub or small tree native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia, valued for its medicinal properties and versatile uses. The health benefits of Tetracera nordtiana var. everillii include its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
